admission.justification: The reader and derived index must agree on the authored JSON half so loss of Markdown does not silently hide invariant entries.

applicability: Storage-eligible onboarding cards with an existing entry half and absent Markdown half.
conditions: The registered reader names the entry half as sidecar-only and the route index recognizes either authored half.
Record states and aggregate cardState are computed independently at the selected code tree; sidecar-only visibility does not make stale entries current.
exclusions: Ordinary storage confinement and unreadable/invalid input refusals remain applicable.

Discovers Markdown and JSON halves together, making JSON-only cards visible to index construction. Existing sidecar-status and suffix-mapping anchors do not cover this discovery step. Deduplicates one source discovered through its two physical halves and creates its route bucket when needed. This is cooperating index behavior for the one card-half invariant, not a new invariant.

statement: A card whose Markdown half is absent is read from its entry half and answered as sidecar-only. A route index recognizes either authored half as coverage; missing Markdown alone does not make that index stale. Record currentness is judged independently from that coverage.
